title: [setup] Scaffold the single-package Moria library
body:
**Category:** setup
**Automation:** auto
**Depends on:** none
**Produces:** `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `rust-toolchain.toml`, `AGENTS.md`, `src/lib.rs`

## Description

Create the Rust 2024 single-package `moria` library and repository instructions required by TECH-001 under REQ-002 and REQ-008. Keep `src/lib.rs` a thin facade, pin Rust 1.95.0 and Bevy 0.19.0, declare the approved narrow dependencies/features, reject the GPU feature on WebAssembly, and preserve root-level `assets/` for Bevy lookup.

## Inputs

- `docs/tdd/overview.md` repository shape, exact checks, and intended `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/tdd/architecture.md` dependency and platform policy
- Cargo and rustup using the versions fixed by the TDD

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The repository is one Cargo library package named `moria`, not a workspace or game binary
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` contains the TDD's exact local gates, module rules, renderer ownership, bounded-resource rules, and scope prohibitions
- [ ] Cargo metadata pins the selected toolchain/dependencies and exposes only the documented capability features
- [ ] The empty facade builds on supported native targets and the GPU feature emits the selected compile-time WebAssembly rejection
- [ ] Tests exist and pass
- [ ] No regressions — all existing tests still pass
